archetype: Organic & Earthy combined with Clean Modernism

rules: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for headings > 32px
Overlines/Labels must be uppercase + tiny + tracking-[0.2em]
Hierarchy Gap Rule: jump between heading and subheading must not exceed 2 Tailwind steps
Headings should use font-medium to font-bold to create contrast with body

shadows: Soft ambient shadows for cards: shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)]
Hover states: -translate-y-1 with stronger shadow shadow-[0_20px_40px_rgb(0,0,0,0.08)]
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border border-white/20 for sticky headers and floating navs. NEVER fully transparent if content scrolls behind.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-stone-200 for clean structural definition.
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-2xl for property cards and main sections, rounded-full for buttons.

layouts.landing: Generous spacing (py-24, gap-8), large typography (up to text-6xl for hero). Asymmetrical grids.
layouts.marketplace: Grid layout: grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 or 4. Card-heavy, high focus on imagery.
layouts.dashboard: Sidebar navigation (w-64) + main content area. High density, grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6. Clear data hierarchy.

motion.hover: Subtle transform and shadow transitions using 'transition-all duration-300 ease-out'. DO NOT use 'transition: all' in plain CSS, use Tailwind classes.
motion.page_transitions: Framer motion for smooth mounting (e.g., initial opacity 0, y 20 -> animate to 1, 0).
motion.micro_interactions: Active states on buttons (scale down 0.98), subtle pulse on new notifications.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text meets 4.5:1 ratio against background. Use text-shadow or gradient overlays on images to ensure text readability.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-button').

component_guidelines.cards: Property cards should have aspect-[4/3] or aspect-[3/2] images, hover zoom effect on image within container, clear price and location typography.
component_guidelines.buttons: Primary CTA uses the primary color (#C05C3D) with white text. Pill-shaped or rounded-full for modern SaaS feel.
component_guidelines.inputs: Shadcn inputs with custom focus rings. Avoid native <select>, use Radix/Shadcn Select component.
component_guidelines.navigation: Sticky top header. MUST use backdrop-blur-xl and bg-white/80. NEVER fully transparent. Desktop: explicit links. Mobile: Hamburger.
component_guidelines.dashboards: Go flat, rectangular, dense styles. Avoid overuse of rounded cards. Use 1px subtle border for definition.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install Google Fonts 'Outfit' and 'Manrope'. Use 'Outfit' for headings and 'Manrope' for body text.
Use Lucide-React for all icons. Icons should have consistent stroke widths (usually 1.5 or 2).
Implement the marketing landing page first, then the property listing/search (marketplace), then the authenticated dashboards (Landlord and Tenant).
Use pure HTML + Tailwind for marketing sections, but strictly use Shadcn components for complex interactive elements (forms, date pickers, tables, dropdowns).
Ensure the hero image has a proper dark overlay (e.g., bg-black/40 to bg-black/60) so the white text layered over it is highly readable.
The UI must be entirely in Spanish (Mexico). Use terms like 'Arrendador', 'Arrendatario', 'Inmuebles', 'Inicia Sesión', 'Regístrate'.
Ensure all buttons, links, and forms have appropriate hover and focus states.
For the marketplace list, build a clear card structure similar to Airbnb with images, Title, Location, and Price/month.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl).
Never use 'transition: all'. Always specify transition properties (e.g. transition-colors, transition-transform).
Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }). Keep natural reading flow (left-aligned).
Every interaction needs micro-animations: hover states, active scaling, entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing. Use Tailwind scales like p-8, p-12, py-24.
Missing categories of images? DO NOT use placeholder text. Reuse provided URLs or adapt.
Never use emoji characters like 🤖🧠 for icons. Use proper SVG libraries.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
